summary: Sends sample hackathon and internship phrases to a Groq AI model and prints the parsed results for a person to read.
purpose: Lets a developer look at how the AI reads quick-add phrases before changing the app.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: to inspect the AI output by hand.
how: Load the API key from the environment file. Build a strict instruction prompt for internships and for hackathons. Send two sample phrases of each kind. Parse and print the replies.
inputs: The Groq API key and four fixed sample phrases.
outputs: Printed phrases and parsed JSON for a person to review.
risks: Each run makes paid calls. The script has no pass or fail checks, so a bad result only shows up when someone reads it.
debug: If the key is missing, check the environment file. If a reply is not JSON, the parse step throws, so read the raw reply and check the prompt.
